# LX Music catalogue modules

Upstream: https://github.com/lyswhut/lx-music-desktop
Revision: ad95d5091c9ed689fa72b5e5c849df65f5a679ce
Copyright: LX Music contributors. See LICENSE and upstream supplementary terms:
https://lxmusic.toside.cn/desktop/license

The musicSdk directory contains upstream files with local modifications.
AnimeUta modified `wy/musicDetail.js` and `wy/songList.js` to recover omitted
metadata by exact ID, preserve ordering and handle missing privileges, and
`tx/songList.js` for complete playlist pagination. Modified files carry local
change notices. AnimeUta's entry, format and request adapters are separate
files. catalog.cjs is generated by
scripts/build-online-catalog.mjs. Search, playlist, lyrics and artwork modules are imported;
upstream player and user script execution are not used.

This software licence does not grant rights to music or third-party services.

Unused upstream example credential comments were removed from
`wy/lyric.js` and `wy/utils/index.js`; runtime behavior is unchanged.
Trailing blank lines were normalized in a few vendor files without changing logic.
